procedural_matters: International Jury heard case no. 4 on September 9th. During that hearing the Jury established that protest was valid and that SWE 8338 was involved in the incident and that she may have broken a rule. The International Jury lodged a protest against SWE 8338 and called a new hearing on September 10h. Before the new hearing started, new facts about validity of case no. 4 were found. Validity of case no. 4 was checked again and it was established that case no. 4 was invalid.
conclusions: There is no reason not to withdraw the protest.
